name: infra_accelerate
title: HuggingFace accelerate fine-tune: prepare(), accumulate(), gather_for_metrics, main-process save
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-infra: the accelerate script the ROADMAP's framework list names
note: A precision trap with one live false positive. MLV601 fires here even though `accelerate.utils.set_seed(args.seed)` is called at line 81: `accelerate.utils.set_seed` / `accelerate.set_seed` are missing from the SEED table in analyzer/src/mlview/knowledge/other_tbl.py, and `is_seeded` only matches a positional seed call through that table. The row is recorded as `acceptable` ONLY so this corpus addition does not turn a shared gate red; the row in `forbiddenAfterFix` is the label it must become in the same commit as the one-line table fix.  UPDATE (hardening round 1, 2026-09-14): the defect named above is fixed, so the rows that were `acceptable` to keep a shared gate green are now `forbidden`, which is what they always should have been.

forbidden.why: the training DataLoader is built with shuffle=True at line 56
the eval DataLoader is built with shuffle=False at line 58
no DataLoader in this file passes num_workers at all, so no worker process is spawned
optimizer.zero_grad() is called at line 113; zeroing at the end of the step rather than the start is the ordering the accelerate examples use and is equally correct
optimizer.step() is called at line 111 after accelerator.backward(loss) at line 109
the order is backward (109) -> clip -> step (111) -> scheduler (112) -> zero_grad (113); the zero_grad follows the step, so nothing wipes a gradient that was about to be applied
the epoch loss is accumulated as running += loss.detach().float().item(), a Python float
evaluate() calls model.eval() at line 64 and restores model.train() at line 75
the evaluation loop is inside `with torch.no_grad():` at line 67
Accelerator.prepare() owns device placement for the model and both dataloaders; moving batches by hand in an accelerate script is the mistake, not the fix
there is no transformers.Trainer in this file at all - the loop is hand-written over accelerate

accelerate.utils.set_seed(args.seed) at line 81 seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda - it is exactly the `seed_everything` the message says is absent, so the finding states something false about this file. Fixed in hardening round 1: `accelerate.utils.set_seed` / `accelerate.set_seed` carry the SEED role.
